title: Reduce Anxiety & Stress with the Physiological Sigh | Huberman Lab Quantal Clip
speaker: Andrew Huberman
zh: 【Andrew Huberman】透過生理嘆息減輕焦慮和壓力| Huberman 實驗室量子夾（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Billions of people suffer from stress and there are tools to combat stress that involve things
cues.en: Billions of people suffer from stress and there are tools to combat stress that involve things
cues.zh: 數十億人承受著壓力，有一些工具可以緩解壓力，其中涉及一些事情

cues.text: like meditation, breath work, good nutrition, good social connections
cues.en: like meditation, breath work, good nutrition, good social connections
cues.zh: 例如冥想、呼吸練習、良好的營養、良好的社交關係

cues.text: and avoiding all bad things in life.
cues.en: and avoiding all bad things in life.
cues.zh: 並避免生活中所有不好的事情。

cues.text: And while those are powerful, the problem is, they require that people step away
cues.en: And while those are powerful, the problem is, they require that people step away
cues.zh: 雖然這些很強大，但問題是，它們要求人們離開

cues.text: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.en: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.zh: 來自誘發壓力的活動。

cues.text: By contrast, my lab and other laboratories have been very interested in developing tools that allow us to push back on stress.
cues.en: By contrast, my lab and other laboratories have been very interested in developing tools that allow us to push back on stress.
cues.zh: 相較之下，我的實驗室和其他實驗室對開發能夠幫助我們緩解壓力的工具非常感興趣。

cues.text: In other words, feel more calm in real time, meaning without having to disengage
cues.en: In other words, feel more calm in real time, meaning without having to disengage
cues.zh: 換句話說，即時感到更加平靜，這意味著無需脫離

cues.text: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.en: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.zh: 來自誘發壓力的活動。

cues.text: The best way that I am aware to do that is called the physiological sigh.
cues.en: The best way that I am aware to do that is called the physiological sigh.
cues.zh: 據我所知，做到這一點的最好方法稱為生理嘆息。

cues.text: A physiological sigh is a pattern of breathing that involves two inhales followed by an extended exhale.
cues.en: A physiological sigh is a pattern of breathing that involves two inhales followed by an extended exhale.
cues.zh: 生理嘆息是一種呼吸模式，涉及兩次吸氣，然後延長呼氣。

cues.text: Physiological sighs were discovered in the 1930s, as a pattern of breathing
cues.en: Physiological sighs were discovered in the 1930s, as a pattern of breathing
cues.zh: 生理嘆息在 20 世紀 30 年代被發現，是一種呼吸模式

cues.text: that people go into spontaneously when they're in claustrophobic environments
cues.en: that people go into spontaneously when they're in claustrophobic environments
cues.zh: 當人們處於幽閉恐怖環境時，他們會自發性地進入

cues.text: or in deep sleep, when there's a buildup of a gas called carbon dioxide in the blood stream.
cues.en: or in deep sleep, when there's a buildup of a gas called carbon dioxide in the blood stream.
cues.zh: 或是在深度睡眠時，血液中會累積一種叫做二氧化碳的氣體。

cues.text: Carbon dioxide triggers the impulse to breathe.
cues.en: Carbon dioxide triggers the impulse to breathe.
cues.zh: 二氧化碳觸發呼吸衝動。

cues.text: There are neurons in the brain that know when carbon dioxide levels have gotten too high.
cues.en: There are neurons in the brain that know when carbon dioxide levels have gotten too high.
cues.zh: 大腦中的神經元知道二氧化碳濃度何時過高。

cues.text: And when the levels get too high, they trigger inhale and exhale, or double inhale and exhale.
cues.en: And when the levels get too high, they trigger inhale and exhale, or double inhale and exhale.
cues.zh: 當水平過高時，它們會觸發吸氣和呼氣，或雙吸氣和呼氣。

cues.text: Now you can do physiological sighs voluntarily, anytime you're feeling too stressed
cues.en: Now you can do physiological sighs voluntarily, anytime you're feeling too stressed
cues.zh: 現在，無論何時您感到壓力過大，您都可以自願進行生理嘆息

cues.text: and you want to feel more calm.
cues.en: and you want to feel more calm.
cues.zh: 你想要感覺更平靜。

cues.text: You do it like this.
cues.en: You do it like this.
cues.zh: 你這樣做。

cues.text: So it's a double inhale.
cues.en: So it's a double inhale.
cues.zh: 所以這是雙吸氣。

cues.text: And typically, the first inhale is longer than the second but the second one is still important to do.
cues.en: And typically, the first inhale is longer than the second but the second one is still important to do.
cues.zh: 通常，第一次吸氣比第二次吸氣要長，但第二次吸氣仍然很重要。

cues.text: And then a very long, extended exhale.
cues.en: And then a very long, extended exhale.
cues.zh: 然後是很長很長的呼氣。

cues.text: Typically, both inhales are through the nose and the exhale is through the mouth.
cues.en: Typically, both inhales are through the nose and the exhale is through the mouth.
cues.zh: 通常，吸氣都是透過鼻子，呼氣是透過嘴巴。

cues.text: That's the most effective way to do the physiological sigh.
cues.en: That's the most effective way to do the physiological sigh.
cues.zh: 這是進行生理嘆息的最有效方法。

cues.text: However, you can't breathe through your nose or your mouth for whatever reason do it all through your mouth or all through your nose.
cues.en: However, you can't breathe through your nose or your mouth for whatever reason do it all through your mouth or all through your nose.
cues.zh: 但是，無論出於何種原因，您都無法透過鼻子或嘴巴呼吸，只能透過嘴巴或鼻子呼吸。

cues.text: The second inhale is really important because your lungs are not just two big bags of air.
cues.en: The second inhale is really important because your lungs are not just two big bags of air.
cues.zh: 第二次吸氣非常重要，因為你的肺部不只是兩大袋空氣。

cues.text: They're two big bags of air with lots of little sacks, millions of sacks.
cues.en: They're two big bags of air with lots of little sacks, millions of sacks.
cues.zh: 它們是兩個大空氣袋，裡面有很多小袋子，數百萬個袋子。

cues.text: And if you were to lay out those sacks, their volume is as big as a tennis court.
cues.en: And if you were to lay out those sacks, their volume is as big as a tennis court.
cues.zh: 如果你把這些麻袋攤開，它們的體積就跟一個網球場一樣大。

cues.text: And that allows both the intake of more oxygen but also the offload of carbon dioxide.
cues.en: And that allows both the intake of more oxygen but also the offload of carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 這樣既可以吸收更多的氧氣，又可以排出二氧化碳。

cues.text: So when you do the double inhale, it reinflates any of these little sacks that have collapsed
cues.en: So when you do the double inhale, it reinflates any of these little sacks that have collapsed
cues.zh: 所以當你進行雙吸氣時，它會重新充氣這些已經塌陷的小袋子

cues.text: and in doing so, it allows you to offload more carbon dioxide.
cues.en: and in doing so, it allows you to offload more carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 這樣做可以讓你排出更多的二氧化碳。

cues.text: So if you're feeling stressed in any circumstance, inhale twice through the nose and then exhale long
cues.en: So if you're feeling stressed in any circumstance, inhale twice through the nose and then exhale long
cues.zh: 因此，如果您在任何情況下感到壓力，請透過鼻子吸氣兩次，然後長時間呼氣

cues.text: through the mouth, if you want, you can repeat it a second or even a third time, but typically, just one or two,
cues.en: through the mouth, if you want, you can repeat it a second or even a third time, but typically, just one or two,
cues.zh: 透過嘴，如果你願意，你可以重複第二次甚至第三次，但通常只重複一兩次，

cues.text: maybe three physiological sighs are sufficient to bring your level of stress
cues.en: maybe three physiological sighs are sufficient to bring your level of stress
cues.zh: 也許三聲生理嘆息就足以帶來你的壓力程度

cues.text: and alertness down very fast and allow you to feel more calm.
cues.en: and alertness down very fast and allow you to feel more calm.
cues.zh: 而且警覺性下降得很快，讓你感覺更平靜。
